items.evidence: Log lines 2-193 show 18 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into each of the 96 pcr_plate wells.
Log shows 1 uL colony A1..H12 into matching pcr wells (with 3x mix), then 1 uL primer from matching wells, all with the P20.
Each colony and each primer transfer has its own pick up/drop tip in the log; the master mix uses one tip into empty wells, which is allowed.
protocol.comment records sealing and the full program: 98C 30 s; 30x[98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s]; 72C 2 min; hold 4C.
Steps and order match the task, the apiLevel 2.15 is in range, and the comments (single tip for master mix, mix 3x) match what the code does.

judge.summary: The protocol performs 18 µL master mix into 96 wells, 1 µL colony with 3x mix, and 1 µL primer, using fresh tips per sample as the log shows. The thermocycling comment is complete and nothing is invented or missing, so all items pass.
